title: Nomination Amendment
text: Home »Legal»Circulars Nomination Amendment Feb 16, 2004| Circulars GENERAL MANAGER INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT SEBI/ IMD/CIR No. 5/ 265 / 2004 February 16, 2004 All Mutual Funds Registered with SEBI Association of Mutual Funds in India Dear Sirs, We are enclosing a copy of the SEBI (Mutual Funds) (Amendment) Regulations, 2004 published in the official gazette on January 15, 2004 for your reference and records. Yours faithfully, SURESH GUPTA Encl: as above.
